outline.name: ISACA CISA Exam Content Outline
outline.version: Job practice effective August 2024 (5 domains, 10 subareas, 60 subtopics)
outline.source: https://www.isaca.org/credentialing/cisa/cisa-exam-content-outline (read via WebFetch; page shows no effective date, the August 2024 date comes from the meta.js header and ISACA's candidate guide it cites)
outline.notes: 60 objectives, one per subtopic (the outline has 60 subtopics: 10, 11, 8, 16, 15 by domain; the count of 63 in the assignment brief does not match ISACA or meta.js, which also has 60), IDs from ISACA's own numbering (domain, subarea letter, subtopic number). Texts are paraphrases, never ISACA's wording; the subtopic titles fetched on 2026-11-07 match meta.js TASKNAMES (ISACA's page says 'Enterprise Architecture and Considerations' for 2A4 and 'Security Monitoring Tools and Techniques' for 5B4; meta.js wording differs slightly, same subtopic). The outline page also lists 43 numbered job-practice task statements (the 'Secondary Classifications: Tasks' list). Those task statements are NOT mapped here yet; this file covers the subtopics only. Domain weights 18/18/12/26/26 per the fetched page.
